rules.statement: Pin the frontend's Node major once, in `.node-version`. Anything that can read a file (CI via `actions/setup-node` `node-version-file`, dev orchestrators, bootstrap scripts) reads that file, and documentation refers to the file instead of naming a version number.
rules.why: A version stated in many places drifts: a runtime move has to find every copy, and each lookup can select an install its own way.
rules.check: Look for a hard-coded Node version in workflows (`node-version:` literals), scripts, AppHost code or docs that should read `.node-version` instead.

rules.statement: When the Node major in `.node-version` changes, update `engines.node` (as the runtime's floor, e.g. `>=26.0.0`) and every `@types/node` range in the same change.
rules.why: These values can't read the file. `engines.node` is also what invalidates Turborepo's task cache when the runtime changes.
rules.check: A diff that changes `.node-version` without matching `engines.node` and `@types/node` updates, or the reverse.

rules.statement: Pin pnpm's exact version in the `packageManager` field and provision it from that pin with pnpm's own tooling (`pnpm/action-setup` in CI, npm global install locally), never through Corepack.
rules.why: Node 25 and later no longer ship Corepack, and reinstalling it adds back a shim layer that Node itself dropped.
rules.check: Look for `corepack enable`/`corepack prepare` or a Corepack install in workflows or scripts, hand-written pnpm install steps in CI, or a `packageManager` without an exact version.

rules.statement: Keep pnpm (like TypeScript) on the newest major that Dependabot officially supports, and don't adopt pnpm features Dependabot can't read, such as newer lockfile formats or `devEngines`.
rules.why: Dependabot reads unsupported pnpm lockfiles as an empty dependency graph, which silently stops security updates.
rules.check: A `packageManager` bump to a pnpm major that Dependabot doesn't support, or `devEngines` added to package.json.

rules.statement: Put every pnpm setting in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, not in `.npmrc` or the `pnpm` field of `package.json`.
rules.why: pnpm 11 and later read settings only from `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.
rules.check: pnpm settings added to `.npmrc` or a `"pnpm"` key in package.json.

rules.statement: Deny dependency install scripts unless reviewed. Keep `strictDepBuilds: true`, and record an explicit `allowBuilds` decision for each dependency with a build script, allowing it only when the dependency can't work without it.
rules.why: Least privilege: an unreviewed script should fail the install instead of printing a warning, and a script should run only when it is actually needed.
rules.check: Look for `strictDepBuilds` being removed or set to false, a new dependency with a build script and no `allowBuilds` entry, or `allowBuilds: true` with no justification.

rules.statement: Pin every third-party GitHub Action to a full commit SHA, not a tag or branch.
rules.why: The ADR says every third-party action is pinned to a commit.
rules.check: `uses: owner/action@v1` or `@main` for a third-party action in a workflow.

rules.statement: When choosing among installed versions (for example, the newest install of a runtime), compare versions numerically, not as text or by directory listing order.
rules.why: Text sorting ranks `22.9.0` above `22.22.2`, and taking the first directory listed picks an arbitrary install.
rules.check: Version strings sorted with ordinal or string comparison, or the first enumerated directory taken, instead of parsing to `System.Version` or similar.
